## 준비: 예제 데이터

이 문서의 모든 예제는 아래에서 만드는 `patients` 데이터를 사용합니다.

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(42)

n <- 40

patients <- tibble(
  pt_id     = paste0("P", sprintf("%03d", 1:n)),
  gender    = sample(c("M", "F"), n, replace = TRUE),
  height    = round(rnorm(n, mean = 168, sd = 10)),
  weight    = round(rnorm(n, mean = 70,  sd = 15)),
  Age       = round(runif(n, min = 30, max = 72)),
  Diagnosis = sample(c("Diabetes", "Hypertension", "Healthy"),
                     n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.35, 0.35, 0.30)),
  disease   = Diagnosis,
  HbA1c     = round(
    case_when(
      Diagnosis == "Diabetes"     ~ rnorm(n, mean = 8.0, sd = 1.0),
      Diagnosis == "Hypertension" ~ rnorm(n, mean = 5.8, sd = 0.7),
      TRUE                        ~ rnorm(n, mean = 5.2, sd = 0.5)
    ), 1)
)

# 비교용 data.frame 버전
patients_df <- as.data.frame(patients)

patients
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 40 × 8
   pt_id gender height weight   Age Diagnosis    disease      HbA1c
   <chr> <chr>   <dbl>  <dbl> <dbl> <chr>        <chr>        <dbl>
 1 P001  M         165     64    67 Hypertension Hypertension   5.9
 2 P002  M         150     73    52 Diabetes     Diabetes       7.1
 3 P003  M         166     79    66 Hypertension Hypertension   6.1
 4 P004  M         180     91    49 Hypertension Hypertension   6  
 5 P005  F         187     59    37 Diabetes     Diabetes       7.6
 6 P006  F         164     90    49 Diabetes     Diabetes       9.1
 7 P007  F         165     75    71 Hypertension Hypertension   6.3
 8 P008  F         150     86    50 Hypertension Hypertension   6.2
 9 P009  M         173     84    41 Diabetes     Diabetes       8.7
10 P010  F         162     81    41 Healthy      Healthy        5.8
# ℹ 30 more rows
```

## tidyverse

`tidyverse` 는 `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `tidyr` 같은 유용한 패키지를 한데 묶은 메타 패키지입니다.

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 설치 (한 번만)
install.packages("tidyverse")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 세션마다 불러오기
library(tidyverse)
```
:::

### data.frame vs. tibble

`tibble` 은 `data.frame` 의 개선판으로, 출력할 때 열의 자료형을 함께 보여주고 큰 데이터도 깔끔하게 다룹니다.

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# data.frame: 모든 행을 출력하고 자료형 정보는 없음
patients_df
```

## 1. 데이터 정리: dplyr

#### group_by() & summarise(): 그룹별 요약

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_group_by.png){fig-align="center" width="258"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  group_by(disease) %>%
  summarize(
    n           = n(),
    mean_weight = round(mean(weight), 1),
    mean_HbA1c  = round(mean(HbA1c),  1)
  )
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 3 × 4
  disease          n mean_weight mean_HbA1c
  <chr>        <int>       <dbl>      <dbl>
1 Diabetes        13        67.8        8  
2 Healthy          9        74.4        5.4
3 Hypertension    18        73.6        5.8
```


:::
:::

### join: 데이터 합치기

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_join.png){fig-align="center" width="251"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 검사 결과 — 일부 환자는 빠져 있고, 코호트 밖 환자가 하나 섞여 있음
lab_results <- tibble(
  pt_id = c("P001", "P002", "P003", "P999"),
  hba1c = c(7.5, 5.8, 6.2, 8.0)
)
```
:::

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_left.png){fig-align="center"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# left_join: 코호트의 모든 환자를 유지
patients %>%
  select(pt_id, disease) %>%
  left_join(lab_results, by = "pt_id")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 40 × 3
   pt_id disease      hba1c
   <chr> <chr>        <dbl>

 6 P006  Diabetes      NA  
 7 P007  Hypertension  NA  
 8 P008  Hypertension  NA  
 9 P009  Diabetes      NA  
10 P010  Healthy       NA  
# ℹ 30 more rows
```

:::

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_right.png){fig-align="center" width="112"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# right_join: 검사 결과를 기준으로

  select(pt_id, disease) %>%
```

```
  pt_id disease      hba1c
  <chr> <chr>        <dbl>
```

### 데이터 구조 바꾸기: tidyr

#### pivot_longer(): Wide → Long

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_pivet_long.png){fig-align="center" width="390"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bp_wide <- tibble(
  pt_id      = c("P001", "P002", "P003"),
  sbp_visit1 = c(120, 130, 110),
  sbp_visit2 = c(118, 135, 115),
  sbp_visit3 = c(115, 132, 112)
)

bp_wide
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 3 × 4
  pt_id sbp_visit1 sbp_visit2 sbp_visit3
  <chr>      <dbl>      <dbl>      <dbl>
1 P001         120        118        115
2 P002         130        135        132
3 P003         110        115        112
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
bp_long <- bp_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("sbp"),
    names_to  = "visit",
    values_to = "sbp"
  )

bp_long
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 9 × 3
  pt_id visit        sbp
  <chr> <chr>      <dbl>
1 P001  sbp_visit1   120
2 P001  sbp_visit2   118
3 P001  sbp_visit3   115
4 P002  sbp_visit1   130
5 P002  sbp_visit2   135
6 P002  sbp_visit3   132
7 P003  sbp_visit1   110
8 P003  sbp_visit2   115
9 P003  sbp_visit3   112
```


:::
:::

#### pivot_wider(): Long → Wide

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_pivot_wider.png){fig-align="center"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bp_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = visit,
    values_from = sbp
  )
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 3 × 4
  pt_id sbp_visit1 sbp_visit2 sbp_visit3
  <chr>      <dbl>      <dbl>      <dbl>
1 P001         120        118        115
2 P002         130        135        132
3 P003         110        115        112
```


:::
:::

#### separate(): 열 나누기

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_separate.png){fig-align="center" width="482"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bp_raw <- tibble(
  pt_id   = c("P001", "P002"),
  bp_full = c("120/80", "130/85")
)

bp_raw %>%
  separate(bp_full, into = c("sbp", "dbp"), sep = "/", convert = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 2 × 3
  pt_id   sbp   dbp
  <chr> <int> <int>
1 P001    120    80
2 P002    130    85
```


:::
:::

#### unite(): 열 합치기

![](/assets/img/part1/W3_unite.png){fig-align="center" width="351"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dates <- tibble(
  pt_id = c("P001", "P002"),
  year  = c("2024", "2025"),
  month = c("12", "01"),
  day   = c("25", "15")
)

dates %>%
  unite(col = "exam_date", year, month, day, sep = "-")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 2 × 2
  pt_id exam_date 
  <chr> <chr>     
1 P001  2024-12-25
2 P002  2025-01-15
```

## 2. 시각화: ggplot2

ggplot2는 세 가지 요소로 이루어집니다.

1)  **data**: 데이터 프레임
2)  **aes**: x축, y축, color, fill, group 등
3)  **geom**: 그래프의 종류

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dataframe %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = xx, y = yy)) +
  geom_function() +
  ...
```
:::

#### 미학 요소 (Aesthetics)

| 속성             | 설명              | 예시                              |
|------------------|-------------------|-----------------------------------|
| `color` / `fill` | 색                | `"red"`, `"#RRGGBB"`              |
| `linetype`       | 선 종류           | `"solid"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"` |
| `size`           | 점 / 글자 크기    | mm 단위                           |
| `linewidth`      | 선 두께           | mm 단위                           |
| `shape`          | 점 모양           | 0~25 정수                         |
| `alpha`          | 투명도            | 0 (투명) ~ 1 (불투명)             |

::: callout-tip
**`aes()` 안에 쓰면**: 변수에 자동으로 대응됩니다 → `aes(color = Diagnosis)`

**`geom_` 안에 쓰면**: 고정값이 됩니다 → `geom_bar(color = 'black')`
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### ① 막대 그래프 (Bar Plot): 범주형 자료의 빈도

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Diagnosis)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue", width = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Number of Patients by Diagnosis",
       x = "Diagnosis", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-21-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### ② 히스토그램 (Histogram): 연속형 변수의 분포

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution", x = "Age", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-22-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### ③ 상자 그림 (Box Plot): 그룹 간 연속형 값 비교

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Diagnosis, y = HbA1c, fill = Diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "HbA1c by Diagnosis", x = "Diagnosis", y = "HbA1c (%)") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-23-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### ④ 산점도 (Scatter Plot): 두 연속형 변수의 관계

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = HbA1c)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = 'darkblue') +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Age vs HbA1c", x = "Age", y = "HbA1c (%)") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-24-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### ⑤ 선 그래프 (Line Plot): 시간에 따른 변화

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bp_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = visit, y = sbp, group = pt_id, color = pt_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Systolic BP Across Visits",
       x = "Visit", y = "SBP (mmHg)", color = "Patient") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-25-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 그래프 꾸미기

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
patients %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Diagnosis, y = HbA1c, fill = Diagnosis)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "HbA1c Levels by Diagnosis",
       x = "Diagnosis", y = "HbA1c (%)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme_classic()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-26-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### 주요 테마 (Theme)

| 테마              | 설명                          |
|-------------------|-------------------------------|
| `theme_classic()` | 흰 배경, 축만 표시            |
| `theme_bw()`      | 흰 배경 + 격자선              |
| `theme_minimal()` | 장식을 최소화                 |
| `theme_light()`   | 밝은 톤                       |

::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output-display}
![](/chapters/part1/W3_wrangling_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-27-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

### 그래프 저장하기

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 확장자에 따라 형식이 자동으로 결정됨
ggsave("results/w3_my_result.png")

# 고해상도 TIFF (논문 투고용)
ggsave("results/w3_Figure1.tiff",
       width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 300)

# PDF (발표용; 확대해도 깨지지 않음)
ggsave("results/w3_Figure1.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## 📝 3주차 과제

아래 데이터(`my_data`)를 사용하세요.

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(7)
my_data <- tibble(
  Sample_ID  = paste0("S", sprintf("%02d", 1:20)),
  Group      = sample(c("Control", "Treatment"), 20, replace = TRUE),
  Gender     = sample(c("Male", "Female"), 20, replace = TRUE),
  Age        = round(runif(20, 25, 65)),
  Gene_A     = round(rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 2), 2),
  Gene_B     = round(rnorm(20, mean = 8, sd = 3), 2),
  Gene_C     = round(rnorm(20, mean = 3, sd = 1), 2)
)

my_data %>% head
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A tibble: 6 × 7
  Sample_ID Group     Gender   Age Gene_A Gene_B Gene_C
  <chr>     <chr>     <chr>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>  <dbl>
1 S01       Treatment Male      57   3.26   7.21   3.43
2 S02       Control   Female    40   6.44   7.98   2.08
3 S03       Control   Female    55   5.22   9.1    2.38
4 S04       Treatment Female    42   4.84  13.1    2.13
5 S05       Control   Male      61   4.16  10.2    1.36
6 S06       Treatment Male      38   3.88   9.44   1.67
```


:::
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
# 4. group_by & summarize: 그룹별 Gene_A 평균

  group_by(___) %>%
  summarize(mean_GeneA = mean(___))

# 5. pivot_longer: Gene_A, Gene_B, Gene_C 를 long 형태로

  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(Gene_A, Gene_B, Gene_C),
    names_to  = "___",
    values_to = "___"
  )
```
